Per the header comment in src/cli/lib/agentLoop.ts, the agent can only claim completion via the **`finish` action** (also called the `finish` tool).

The comment explicitly states:

> the SAME honesty contract as the manager: a tool reports what it really did, and the agent can only claim completion via the `finish` action

This is also reflected in the protocol description: every agent turn is either a tool call or a completion via `{"finish":"summary"}`. The `finish` tool definition confirms this: "Call ONLY when the task is fully done; summarize what you did."
